terms.grammar: phrase: ūtilis with ad and the gerund
terms.comment: A plain description in a classical construction (ūtilis ad with a gerund or noun); ad docendum aptus says the same from the teacher’s side.
Greek διδασκαλικός; ante- and post-classical and rare (Didascalica, the title of a work by Accius; Ausonius): Lewis & Short.

phrases.latin: Hic lūdus et jūcundus est et ad discendum ūtilis.
phrases.english: This game is fun and educational.

sources: Lewis & Short: utilis · Lewis & Short: didascalicus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 52, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
